name: Brogue shoes

image.caption: Pair of full brogue shoes by Santoni

lead: Brogues are leather shoes marked by rows of small perforations and serrated edges, usually on the toe cap and seams. The detail gives a plain outfit more texture and character, and the style is common in smart-casual and tailored wardrobes.
Men building a wardrobe use them as a step between formal plain-toe dress shoes and casual footwear. The appearance payoff is a more polished, put-together outfit rather than any change to the body.

paras: Forum members describe wearing brogues with suits, chinos and even kilts. One T Nation poster listed converse for casual days, boots for wet weather, smart shoes for occasions and brogues with a kilt.[2] Another thread on building a wardrobe mentions a budget of about $250 for a quality pair of light brown dress shoes, with the $200-300 range cited as typical for durable leather.[1] Brown shoes with a navy suit is a pairing discussed in a suit-colour thread.[3]

Footwear carries few risks. Poor fit can cause blisters, and leather dress shoes need regular care such as polishing and resoling to last. Heavy perforation is generally treated as more casual than a plain toe.

angle.text: Brogues change the impression a shoe makes, adding detail to jeans or chinos and giving suits a less severe look. The effect is on presentation, not on the body.

lead: Brogue shoes are leather shoes decorated with perforations, called broguing, along the seams and often on the toe cap. They are used in men's style to add visual interest to an outfit, and forum discussions treat them as one option within a basic dress-shoe wardrobe.

On T Nation's style threads, members asking how to build a wardrobe cite a budget around $200-300 for well-made dress shoes expected to last a long time.[1] Others mention brogues alongside converse and boots as one choice in a rotation chosen by occasion.[2] Colour pairing also comes up: a suit thread discusses brown shoes and belt with navy, while others prefer black.[3]
No clinical or controlled research addresses brogues; they are a clothing choice in the style category of the wiki.

paras: Brogues are defined by their perforated detailing rather than by a single cut, so the term covers several shoe shapes. Members of a T Nation wardrobe thread discuss light brown dress shoes as a first quality purchase.[1]
Style threads treat footwear as part of the overall outfit. Posters mention brogues in the context of kilts and smart outfits,[2] and advise on matching shoe colour to suits and belts.[3]

Forum members commonly quote $200-300 for durable leather shoes and describe wanting a pair that will last a long time.[1] Colour choice follows the outfit: brown with navy suits is a pairing members discuss.[3]
